verses.transliteration: Taa-Seeen-Meeem

translations.text: Ta, Seen, Meem.

verses.transliteration: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen

translations.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

translations.text: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
verses.transliteration: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

translations.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

translations.text: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

translations.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

translations.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen

translations.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

verses.transliteration: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon

translations.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon

translations.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon

translations.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

translations.text: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

verses.transliteration: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen

translations.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen

translations.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen

translations.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

verses.transliteration: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen

translations.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

translations.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

verses.transliteration: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

translations.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

verses.transliteration: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen

translations.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen

translations.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen

translations.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

verses.text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

translations.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen

translations.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

verses.transliteration: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem

translations.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

verses.transliteration: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom

translations.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.

verses.transliteration: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon

translations.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

translations.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

translations.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

translations.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

translations.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

translations.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

translations.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

verses.transliteration: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen

translations.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

verses.transliteration: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

verses.transliteration: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon

translations.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een

translations.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon

translations.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

translations.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

verses.transliteration: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen

translations.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

verses.transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon

translations.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

verses.transliteration: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon

translations.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,

verses.transliteration: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon

translations.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "

verses.transliteration: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs

verses.transliteration: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem

translations.text: And treasures and honorable station -

verses.transliteration: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

verses.transliteration: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen

translations.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

translations.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen

translations.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

translations.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

verses.transliteration: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen

translations.text: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.

verses.transliteration: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een

translations.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

verses.transliteration: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen

translations.text: Then We drowned the others.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem

translations.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon

translations.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen

translations.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

verses.transliteration: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon

translations.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

verses.transliteration: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon

translations.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

translations.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

verses.transliteration: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon

translations.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

verses.transliteration: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon

translations.text: You and your ancient forefathers?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen

translations.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

verses.transliteration: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen

translations.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

verses.transliteration: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen

translations.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

verses.transliteration: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen

translations.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

verses.transliteration: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen

translations.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen

translations.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen

translations.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

translations.text: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.

verses.transliteration: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem

translations.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

translations.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

verses.transliteration: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon

translations.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon

translations.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

translations.text: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

verses.transliteration: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen

translations.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

verses.transliteration: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween

translations.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

verses.text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

translations.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

verses.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

translations.text: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"

verses.transliteration: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon

translations.text: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators

verses.transliteration: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon

translations.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

verses.transliteration: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon

translations.text: They will say while they dispute therein,

verses.text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

translations.text: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

verses.transliteration: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon

translations.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

verses.transliteration: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een

translations.text: So now we have no intercessors

verses.transliteration: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem

translations.text: And not a devoted friend.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

translations.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen

translations.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon

translations.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me."

verses.transliteration: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon

translations.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

translations.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon

translations.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

verses.transliteration: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen

translations.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

verses.transliteration: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

translations.text: I am only a clear warner."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

translations.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

translations.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

translations.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

verses.transliteration: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen

translations.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen

translations.text: 'Aad denied the messengers

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon

translations.text: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon

translations.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

verses.transliteration: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon

translations.text: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?

verses.transliteration: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen

translations.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.transliteration: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon

translations.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

verses.transliteration: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen

translations.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

verses.transliteration: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: And gardens and springs.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem

translations.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen

translations.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

verses.transliteration: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen

translations.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

verses.transliteration: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen

translations.text: And we are not to be punished."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen

translations.text: Thamud denied the messengers

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon

translations.text: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen

translations.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

verses.transliteration: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: Within gardens and springs

verses.transliteration: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem

translations.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

verses.transliteration: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen

translations.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.transliteration: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen

translations.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon

translations.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

verses.transliteration: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

translations.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

translations.text: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem

translations.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

verses.transliteration: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen

translations.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen

translations.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen

translations.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon

translations.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

translations.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen

translations.text: Do you approach males among the worlds

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

translations.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

translations.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

verses.transliteration: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen

translations.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

verses.transliteration: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon

translations.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

verses.transliteration: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

translations.text: So We saved him and his family, all,

verses.transliteration: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen

translations.text: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

verses.transliteration: Summa dammarnal aa khareen

translations.text: Then We destroyed the others.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen

translations.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen

translations.text: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

translations.text: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

verses.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.text: So fear Allah and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

translations.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

verses.transliteration: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem

translations.text: And weigh with an even balance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

translations.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

verses.transliteration: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen

translations.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."

verses.transliteration: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

translations.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

translations.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

translations.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem

translations.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.transliteration: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.text: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen

translations.text: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

verses.transliteration: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen

translations.text: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -

verses.transliteration: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen

translations.text: In a clear Arabic language.

verses.transliteration: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen

translations.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

verses.transliteration: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen

translations.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen

translations.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.

verses.transliteration: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen

translations.text: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

translations.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

verses.transliteration: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

translations.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

verses.transliteration: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon

translations.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

verses.transliteration: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

translations.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

verses.transliteration: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen

translations.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

verses.transliteration: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon

translations.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon

translations.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

translations.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

verses.transliteration: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

verses.transliteration: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen

translations.text: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.

verses.transliteration: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon

translations.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

verses.transliteration: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon

translations.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

translations.text: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

verses.transliteration: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen

translations.text: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen

translations.text: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

translations.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

verses.transliteration: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem

translations.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

verses.transliteration: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom

translations.text: Who sees you when you arise

verses.transliteration: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen

translations.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.

verses.transliteration: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

translations.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.transliteration: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen

translations.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

verses.transliteration: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem

translations.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.

verses.transliteration: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon

translations.text: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

verses.transliteration: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon

translations.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

translations.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

verses.transliteration: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon

translations.text: And that they say what they do not do? -

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon

translations.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
